name: GE Vernova
old_description: Manufactures power generation, grid, and electrical equipment including transformers and switchgear (spun off from GE).
about:
GE Vernova, headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, began operations in 2024 as a spin-off from General Electric to focus on the global energy transition. The company carries forward the GE legacy while adopting a new identity—“Ver” for green and “Nova” for new—signaling its commitment to lower-carbon energy.

The company designs and manufactures a broad portfolio of power generation, grid, and electrical equipment, including transformers, switchgear, wind turbines, and gas turbines. Its installed base comprises roughly 59,000 wind turbines and 7,000 gas turbines, which together help generate about 25% of the world’s electricity. GE Vernova employs approximately 85,000 people across more than 100 countries, with its global headquarters in Cambridge serving as a hub for engineering and innovation.

GE Vernova serves the power generation, electrical grid, renewable energy, and nuclear energy sectors. Its technologies are deployed in utility-scale wind farms, gas-fired power plants, grid stabilization projects—such as a custom engineering effort in Brazil—and small modular reactor development. Customers include utilities, independent power producers, and industrial operators seeking to decarbonize their energy supply.

The company’s stated mission is to “electrify to thrive and decarbonize,” with a target of carbon neutrality in its own facilities and operations by 2030. Leadership emphasizes that the scale of its installed base and its digital capabilities, such as AI-driven turbine inspections using digital twins, differentiate its ability to accelerate the energy transition.

name: GO GREEN Food Packaging Solutions from CPT (Coextruded Plastic Technologies) Inc.
old_description: EPR Readiness Guide: Navigating Packaging Regulations in the U.S
about:
Coextruded Plastic Technologies (CPT) Inc., operating as GO GREEN Food Packaging Solutions, was founded in 2001 in Janesville, Wisconsin. The company began with the founders' entrepreneurial drive to develop green thermoforming capabilities for packaging.

The company manufactures thermoformed trays and lidding solutions for food and medical packaging. Its proprietary Go Green thermoforming technology reduces carbon footprint by up to 28% compared to conventional methods. Product lines include GO-POLYPRO™ polypropylene trays, GO-PAPER™ paper-based trays, GO-VSP™ vacuum skin packaging, and GO-OVERWRAP™ overwrap solutions, as well as pre-padded trays in various colors and compartment configurations. The company holds several patents for its tray designs, such as the Zazin tray with beveled sidewalls that save 40% in cube space.

GO GREEN serves the food packaging and medical packaging sectors. Its solutions address needs such as extended shelf life, modified atmosphere packaging (MAP), vacuum skin packaging (VSP), oven- and microwave-safe trays, and sustainability goals including recyclability and reduced carbon footprint. Customers include food processors seeking brand-differentiated tray designs and medical device manufacturers requiring sterile packaging.

The company was founded to pioneer environmentally responsible thermoforming. It differentiates itself with capabilities such as the only polypropylene tray that can be registered printed, a Flex Flange design compatible with conventional overwrap equipment, and a thermoforming process that cuts carbon emissions by up to 28%. The Zazin tray’s beveled sidewall design reduces shipping volume by 40%, offering supply chain savings.

name: GTX Manufacturing, LLC
old_description: We are a full service contract manufacturing company with over 40 years of combined experience in wire harness / cable assembly / electromechanical assembly.
about:
GTX Manufacturing, LLC operates from Clay City, Kentucky, where it provides contract manufacturing services specializing in wire harnesses, cable assemblies, and electromechanical assemblies. The company describes itself as a full-service contract manufacturer with over 40 years of combined experience among its personnel.

The shop’s core capabilities include wire harness assembly (with harnesses exceeding 300 circuits), cable assembly, semi-automatic crimping, ultrasonic wire splicing (Sonobond), inkjet and hot-stamp wire marking (using a KIP 20 machine), connector overmolding and rubber injection molding for environmental protection, potting and encapsulating, J-STD-001 soldering, IPC-620A workmanship, 100% electrical testing on Cirris equipment, reverse engineering, and general box-build assembly. Prototyping and low-run production are offered alongside volume work.

GTX serves customers in automotive, heavy-equipment, trailer, and trucking markets, producing engine and chassis harnesses, trailer harnesses, dump-truck harnesses, and heavy-equipment harnesses. The company works with major connector brands such as Deutsch, Molex, Tyco, Yazaki, Sumitomo, and JST.

GTX emphasizes lean manufacturing and ISO 9001 principles to deliver cost-competitive solutions, and highlights its ability to provide full production solutions from prototyping through final assembly.

GWA Solar operates from Altoona, Iowa, serving clients across the Midwest including Des Moines and Ames. The company brings over 25 years of energy project experience to its solar design and installation work, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names have not been shared.

The firm provides turnkey solar solutions covering design, installation, monitoring, maintenance, and system optimization. Its services also include consulting for solar projects, with capabilities spanning residential, commercial, and utility-scale installations. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

GWA Solar works with utilities, solar photovoltaic equipment manufacturers, suppliers, and engineering firms throughout the Midwest. Its customer base includes organizations seeking design, installation, and ongoing maintenance of solar energy systems.

The company distinguishes itself as the only Iowa-based firm with two North American Board of Certified Energy Practitioners (NABCEP) certified solar PV installers. It emphasizes long-standing relationships with utilities and equipment manufacturers as a foundation for quality-assured work.

name: Gagne Foods
old_description: Gagne Foods is a family-run company proudly manufacturing fine frozen baked goods on the coast of Maine. Taste is the cornerstone of our brand.
about:
Gagne Foods operates from Bath, Maine, as a family-owned manufacturer of frozen baked goods. The company has not publicly disclosed its founding year or the names of its founders, but it emphasizes a family-run heritage and a commitment to taste as its cornerstone.

The product line centers on artisanal laminated dough, yielding items such as all-butter biscuits, hand pies, scones, galettes, pie bites, cinnamon rolls, and take-and-bake pastries. All items are sold frozen and ready to bake, with the company also offering contract manufacturing and custom program development for bakery and food-service clients.

Customers include food-service operators, retail bakeries, and brands seeking private-label frozen pastries. Gagne Foods works with regional and seasonal product requests, providing tailored formulations and merchandising support to drive sales for its partners.

The company differentiates itself through a clean-label philosophy — simple, real ingredients — and a focus on buttery, flaky dough made with all butter. It positions taste as the primary driver, aiming to build community around its products without compromising on flavor.

name: Ganim DRE Warsaw - Surgical & Medical Device Sales
old_description: We are here to help you save and simplify your purchasing asset management process.
about:
Didage Sales Company began in 1990 in Clunette, Indiana, when Chris and Julie Rankin founded the business to supply hospitals, surgery centers, and other healthcare facilities with quality new, used, and refurbished medical equipment. The operation later moved to nearby Warsaw, Indiana, where it remains headquartered today.

The company refurbishes used medical equipment, specializing in surgical tables such as the Steris Amsco 5085, 4085, C-Max, and 3085 models. Its services include surgery center development and equipment planning, operating room and clinical equipment sales, equipment repairs and preventive maintenance, and surplus asset disposition. Each piece passes through a quality control department to verify it meets original manufacturer specifications, and all refurbished items carry a warranty.

Customers range from hospitals and ambulatory surgery centers to broader healthcare networks; Unity Healthcare's director of operations, Margie Hale, has publicly praised the team's support. The firm positions itself as a single source for capital equipment needs, handling everything from initial facility planning to ongoing maintenance and eventual asset disposal.

The Rankins started the business after recognizing the pressure on healthcare providers to find affordable, reliable equipment. The 2018 merger with Surgical Power expanded the sales team and streamlined operations, reinforcing a model built on refurbishment, warranty-backed sales, and end-to-end asset management.

name: Gateway Cable Company
old_description: Gateway Cable is one of the nation's leading manufacturers specializing in military power distribution.
about:
Gateway Cable Company was founded in 1979 by Dennis Flerlage in Bensenville, Illinois, before relocating to its current headquarters in Lisle, Illinois. The company is wholly owned and operated in the United States, with a Midwest location chosen for efficient shipping to both coasts and international access via Chicago's O'Hare International Airport, 45 minutes away.

The company manufactures electrical connectors, cable assemblies, and power distribution components for military and commercial applications. Its product line includes NATO intervehicle connectors, receptacles, adaptors, military hardware, receptacle assemblies, power cable assemblies, and in-line fuse assemblies for battery and starter cables. Gateway Cable provides prototyping, engineering, and manufacturing services from an ISO 9001:2015 and CMMC certified facility, and also performs aluminum casting for caps and bodies.

Primary customers include the U.S. military—with procurement approval from the Army Tank-Automotive Command—and allied defense interoperability systems. The company also serves aerospace, industrial, agriculture, construction, and transportation sectors, supplying components for commercial use in those industries.

Gateway Cable emphasizes that all component materials are traceable to U.S. origins and DFAR compliant, and it highlights its commitment to complying with customer demands while providing high-quality products. The company also supports the Wounded Warrior Project and the USO.
